prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW aquarium game asset, not the reference character. Match the REFERENCE illustration's friendly CARTOON visual language: chunky rounded simplified silhouette, strong clean dark brown outlines, bold appealing shapes, expressive oversized glossy eyes if the animal has eyes, warm layered hand-painted cel shading and broad clean highlights. Cute stylized mobile-game character, NOT scientific drawing, realistic rendering, fine anatomical filaments or washed-out watercolor. No otter traits or otter accessories. Subject: An ornate EPIC STAR CONSTELLATION MANTA RAY, majestic deep navy velvet diamond wings, intricate silver and cyan constellations engraved across wings, opalescent golden edge filigree, luminous pearl spots, graceful curled cephalic lobes and long tail. Rich layered details and jewel shimmer but animal readable. Front/dorsal view symmetric, head at bottom, tail above. Transparent glows contained around fins. Front or top three-quarter view, upright, same orientation throughout. Maintain cute cartoon foundation. EPIC grade: visibly luxurious intricate luminous patterns, jewel/pearl highlights, layered fins and rich color depth, considerably more ornate and detailed while keeping cartoon silhouette. OUTPUT a square 2x2 ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET: four equal square cells edge-to-edge, exactly ONE same character in each cell. Use thumbnail reference as exact character identity, same size and position relative to each cell. Four subtle tail and fin swimming phases. Each creature occupies central 68% of its cell with generous padding, no body turning or translation. Grid must have no visible lines. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, words, watermarks, grid, labels.
